svg.text: claudia creates — E10.27 Edit this layout… and New layout…

Mock round of 24 Nov 2026, for review. Content is invented. Agreed in the grill: Text, List and Picture placeholders; two style fields; a built-in layout is copied, not changed; nobody locks a layout.
The entries are the ones this story builds. All layouts… (E10.26) and Apply layout… (E10.5) are greyed; keys are provisional until checked against the key table.
B · Edit this layout…: the layout opens as a slide
Same canvas, tools and undo as a slide. The strip on the left lists the layouts. Nobody locks the layout: another person may edit a slide of it meanwhile.
12 slides follow it · 1 other here. Changes apply to all of them.
Dashed frames are placeholders: purpose, style and hint show while editing and nothing in the show.
The logo, the footer line and the number are layout objects: every slide that follows shows them.
For a free object you pasted.
A · Format ▸ Layout: the entries of this story
Key hints are provisional; the AltGr rule rules out Ctrl+Alt+letter.
Edit this layout… opens the layout of the current slide. New layout… makes a copy of it and opens
that. On a slide whose layout is built in, Edit this layout… says so (D below). The slide's layout
chip and the layout strip come with E10.5, and a deck without slides with E10.26.
Same entries in the web page, the Linux client and the Windows/macOS client.
It starts as a copy of the layout of the slide you are on and opens in the editor.
Compare two things, with a picture below
Starts as a copy of “Two lists”: its placeholders and the objects on it.
A name that is taken is refused in words. Cancel makes nothing.
D · A built-in layout is not changed
The slide is on Basic, which ships with claudia and cannot be edited.
“Basic” is built in and cannot be changed.
You can make a layout of your own from it and edit that. The slide
stays on Basic until you choose the new layout for it.
E · Make placeholder: a free object becomes one
Frame and look stay. A text box's words become the hint; a picture is dropped and its frame stays.
Free text box (not on the layout yet)
the claim” is its hint now.
F · The panel refuses a purpose that is taken
In words, in the field, and nothing changes until it is a free one.
Right list stays as it was.
The same sentence as in the
G · A Picture placeholder in the panel
Words take no style; the picture fills the frame and keeps its proportions.
A slide's picture takes this frame when it is put on the layout: it is cut to fill, never stretched.
Alt text stays with the slide's picture, not with the layout (E1.13).
